windowMask.excludedStructure: The bamboo blind, vertical mullion, right frame, and wooden sill are outside the mask.

pipeline.method: All states use one 1200x1600 master. Deterministic RGB color grading is applied to the full room, then a graded exterior is composited through the same feathered window mask. No geometry, furniture, camera, crop, or anchor transform changes by state.
